instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_20_combo_profile.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Before starting the work, launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_20_combo_profile.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Combine the three existing rectangles into a single profile: a 160 x 30 base plate, a 40 x 25 upper-left boss, and a 50 x 40 upper-right boss. The bosses share edges with the base plate. Add two diameter 10 holes on the base at (40,15) and (120,15). Add one diameter 6 hole centered in each upper boss, at (20,42.5) and (135,50). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_20.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
